our_analytical_conclusion: For the pilot unnormalised positive shortest-time kernels, each point value is nondecreasing with increasing half-time; this is not diffusion, mass-conserving density smoothing or a theorem about functional hierarchy.
duplicate_independent_evidence_warning: The two Kuzmin et al.2023 publications are successive stages of the same422settlement study, not two independent empirical validations.
